_editing: The About area, used by the homepage summary and in full on /about. `photo.src` takes the final portrait (drop the file in /public/images and reference it, e.g. "/images/ketan-about.jpg"); left empty it falls back to the site portrait. `intro` and `motto` are the lead statement that sits beside the photo. `bring`, `whyRunning` and `priorities` are the three blocks of the candidate's own copy, in the order they appear on the page — every word in them is the campaign's, not drafted here. Anything left in [SQUARE BRACKETS] renders with a visible placeholder flag.
title: Ketan Purohit

photo.alt: Ketan Purohit, candidate for TDSB Ward 12 Trustee

intro: Elect trustee Ketan Purohit for TDSB Ward 12

bring.title: What do I bring?
paragraphs: Hi, I am Ketan Purohit, and I bring over 30 years of experience working with municipalities and public institutions, giving me a strong understanding of governance, accountability, and community needs. As a Mechanical Engineering graduate, a devoted husband of 34 years, and the proud father of two successful children, I understand the importance of quality education and strong family values.

For more than 25 years, I have been actively involved in youth programs and volunteer work with non-profit organizations, helping young people reach their full potential. Having lived and traveled in diverse communities around the world, I value inclusion, respect, and opportunity for all. As your School Trustee, I am committed to supporting student success, strengthening partnerships with families, and ensuring responsible stewardship of education resources.

whyRunning.title: Why I am running
items: A safe and respectful learning environment as a fundamental human right.
Equal opportunities for success as per their own qualities and strengths.
Strong moral and character development to become a better citizen.
Support for mental well-being for reducing crime and increasing family values.
Schools that work together with families and communities for inclusion and representation.
